statement: The mean of a steady RANS solution stands for the time-mean drag of the real, unsteady wake
rationale: simpleFoam finds a steady state; the wake behind a bike and rider sheds eddies. On the finer meshes of the tutorial's ladder the drag area does not settle but cycles (1.0 to 1.7% of its mean at the finest, measured on 2026-10-23), which says the flow is not steady

mechanism.how: An engineer with CFD experience reads the drag history of each mesh and the wake pictures, and judges whether the steady mean is a fair stand-in for the time-mean drag at this accuracy
